**What happened** — a clear description of the misbehavior.

**What should have happened** — the expected behavior.

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Go to '…'
2. Tap '…'
3. See '…'

**Environment** — browser/OS (or desktop shell build), signed in / guest, course & lesson if relevant.

**Screenshots** — if the UI is affected.

Does it involve scripture text? If yes, note the reference — verse issues are verified against the KJV text and treated as release blockers.
